descriptors.concept_name: Financial Statement Extracts of Listed Entities
descriptors.definition: Published corporate reports illustrate practical applications such as proposed final dividends subject to shareholder approval and post-reporting period subsidiary share acquisitions. These disclosures demonstrate how entities report significant subsequent events and corporate actions occurring after the reporting date.
inclusion: Proposed final dividends pending shareholder approval
Post-reporting date equity share acquisitions in subsidiaries
exclusion: Adjusted figures for non-approvable events prior to reporting date
Unapproved management estimates without corporate action
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from recognized liabilities by remaining subject to approval at the annual general meeting.

descriptors.concept_name: Comparative Standards: Ind AS 10 Versus AS 4
descriptors.definition: Significant structural variations exist between reporting frameworks regarding material non-adjusting events, going concern implications, loan covenant breaches, and the distribution of non-cash assets. These divergences dictate differing disclosure locations and accounting treatment for events occurring after the balance sheet date.
nearby_distinctions: Ind AS 10 requires financial statement disclosure for material non-adjusting events whereas AS 4 mandates disclosure in the approving authority report.

descriptors.concept_name: Carve Out in Ind AS 10 from IAS 10
descriptors.definition: When a material provision of a long-term loan arrangement is breached on or before the reporting date rendering the liability payable on demand, a lender waiver obtained before financial statement approval is classified as an adjusting event. Conversely, international standards do not treat post-period lender waivers regarding covenant breaches as adjusting events.
inclusion: Post-reporting date lender waivers for pre-existing loan breaches treated as adjusting events
exclusion: Waivers obtained after financial statement approval for issue
nearby_distinctions: Unlike IAS 10 which treats post-period non-demand agreements as non-adjusting, Ind AS 10 treats pre-year-end covenant breach waivers secured prior to approval as adjusting.
